Meeting mode Holds reminders while you present or listen in. Turns itself off after 90 minutes.
Pause reminders Stops all reminders and keeps both timers at zero until you turn this off.

Quick stretch

A short buzz to stand up, rest your eyes and drink water. The long-break timer keeps counting.

Long break

A walk away from the desk. Staying away for the walk length, or locking the PC for a couple of minutes, starts both timers again from zero.

Settings

Start with Windows Opens Desk Pager quietly in the system tray when you sign in.
Also notify on this PC Shows a silent Windows notification together with each phone buzz.

This QR code contains your private pairing code. Keep this tab off screen shares.

Pair your phone

  1. Install and open Desk Pager on your phone.
  2. Tap Scan QR code and point it at this screen.

Buzzes travel through ntfy.sh, a free notification service. No account needed.

Can't scan?

Copy this pairing code to your phone. In Desk Pager there, tap Enter code instead and paste it. Anyone who has the code can buzz your phone, so it stays hidden until you choose Show.

Check that it works

Sends one buzz to every paired phone.

Get a new code

Use this if the code or QR code was ever seen by someone else.

Warning: the current code stops working at once. Every paired phone gets no more buzzes until you pair it again with the new code.
